US Bank Customers Locked Out of Accounts Due to Technical Glitch

Thousands of customers in the United States have been locked out of their bank accounts due to a technical glitch. Reports indicate that the issue affected accounts, causing panic among customers. The problem has been described as a bug that froze accounts.
